record.question: Bleeding time is prolonged in-
record.explanation: Answer D: Von Willebrand disease. Von Willebrand disease impairs platelet adhesion and commonly prolongs bleeding time; the other listed deficiencies do not classically produce that pattern. Reference: https://www.nhlbi.nih.gov/files/docs/guidelines/vwd.pdf; https://www.cdc.gov/von-willebrand/about/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
